svg.text: Small-sun retention | original and actual native shaft-height section
Red M290 ring, ochre M267 sleeve, blue M269 drum. Unchanged calibration; hub and casting contours remain inferred.
Ring center uses source x1285. Groove collar and counterbores provide nominal static retention.
M265 bush / M266 cap joint is unresolved. This stage does not validate the adjacent bearing or drum profile.
